answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fake identities. An identity earns only after serving 12 unrelated counterparties across a ridge of independent markets, not one closed circle. A velvet seller trading only with its own clones never reaches 12, and its cluster shows in umber on the trade graph. Faking 1,000 identities needs 12,000 partners: at 20 units each, 240,000 units, while one honest agent pays 20 units once and keeps undiluted rewards.
